questions: How many devices did you fabricate and measure, and how many showed the e/3 resonances and the 2e/3 steps? The contributions say "M.V. fabricated the devices" (p. 8).
If other devices were measured, why were they set aside?
Which ranges of field, VT and Vdot did you measure beyond those in Table I, in particular around the VT window of Fig. 4f?
What does the second-best example of a vanishing charge sector look like, for instance at another gate configuration from Extended Data Fig. 10?
Are the merging lines in Fig. 4f the same on repeated sweeps and in both sweep directions, and did you measure gate leakage at ν = 1/3?
In Fig. 4f, do all charge-degeneracy lines share one slope, or do you see a second slope or anticrossings that would point to a second compressible region? What diamond height do you find in Fig. 4g?

Fig. 1j assumes lever arm and capacitance "determined primarily by geometry" (p. 3), and the Luttinger fits fix "the quasiparticle charge fixed to e∗ = e/3" (Extended Data Fig. 3, p. 16). Does a fit with e* free return e/3, and what ∆VDC lies behind "EC = 3e ∆VDC ≈ 300 µeV" (Fig. 1, p. 2)?

How many gate windows did you scan before choosing the "particularly pronounced even-odd effect" of Fig. 4e (p. 8), and could you share the data and the dip-finding code behind Extended Data Figs. 9 and 10?
